item.title: Parents Overnight Suite at Bustamante Hospital for Children officially opened
item.description: The Parents Overnight Suite at the Bustamante Hospital for Children in Kingston was officially opened yesterday. The 36-bed facility constructed at a cost of over 140 million dollars, will provide safe and comfortable on-site accommodation for parents and guardians of children receiving inpatient care. item.title: Senate approves Criminal Records Amendment Act 2025
item.description: The Senate yesterday approved the Criminal Records (Rehabilitation of Offenders) (Amendment) Act 2025. The act allows for the removal of certain convictions from a person's criminal record after a rehabilitation period. The post Senate approves Criminal Records Amendment Act 2025 appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: PM says Jamaica is on track to record lowest number of monthly murders
item.description: Prime Minister Dr. Andrew Holness says for the first time in decades, Jamaica is expected to record, this January, the lowest number of murders in a single month. In 2025, the country saw a major reduction in crime, ending with 673 murders, the lowest in 31 years. The post PM says Jamaica is on track to record lowest number of monthly murders appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: Culture Minister lauds Bob Clarke for his contributions to growth of reggae music and Jamaica’s number 1 radio station IRIE FM
item.description: Culture and Entertainment Minister, Olivia Grange praised Bob Clarke during the Reggae Month church service, at Fellowship Tabernacle, in Kingston today.
